Man Fatally Shot by US Immigration Agent in Texas

A Mexican immigrant, Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, was fatally shot by a federal immigration agent in Texas while en route to work. His family discovered his death through news reports and is calling for an independent investigation into the incident. Questions are being raised about the circumstances surrounding the shooting.
